args.code:
import math
X=0.0;Y=0.0;YAW=0.0
PTS=[]
mode='rev'
fwd_start=None
gi=0
gt=0.0
GSEQ=[64,-64,64,-64,160,-160]
lastprint=-10
nfwd=0
woke_over=False

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def clamp(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,YAW,PTS,mode,fwd_start,gi,gt,lastprint,nfwd,woke_over
    t=obs['t']; dt=obs.get('dt',0.1) or 0.1
    mo=obs['motion']; v=mo['v_mps']; st=obs['steer_deg']
    YAW+=v*math.tan(math.radians(st))/2.5*dt
    X+=v*math.cos(YAW)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(YAW)*dt
    c=math.cos(YAW); s=math.sin(YAW)
    views=obs.get('views') or {}
    for k,vw in views.items():
        if not vw: continue
        o=vw.get('origin',[0,0])
        for w in vw.get('walls',[]) or []:
            b,d=w[0],w[1]
            px=o[0]+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)); py=o[1]+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))
            PTS.append((t,X+px*c-py*s,Y+px*s+py*c))
    PTS=[p for p in PTS if t-p[0]<5.0]
    if len(PTS)>1500: PTS=PTS[-1500:]
    # gaze schedule
    head=obs['head']
    if head.get('settled'):
        if gt==0: gt=t
        if t-gt>0.8:
            gi=(gi+1)%len(GSEQ); gt=0
    look=GSEQ[gi]
    rig=obs['rig']; R=rig['trailer_rear']; hw=rig.get('trailer_half_width',1.2)
    hitch=obs['hitch_deg']
    status=obs['status']
    prog=obs.get('progress',{})
    rem=prog.get('remaining',99)
    if rem is not None and rem< -1.5 and not woke_over:
        woke_over=True; wake('passed bay centre? remaining %.1f'%rem)
    # forward recovery
    if mode=='rev' and (abs(hitch)>42 or status in ('JACKKNIFED','PINNED')):
        mode='fwd'; fwd_start=(X,Y); nfwd+=1
        if nfwd>3: wake('many pull-forwards')
    if mode=='fwd':
        dist=math.hypot(X-fwd_start[0],Y-fwd_start[1])
        if (abs(hitch)<8 and dist>1.0) or dist>2.5:
            mode='rev'
        else:
            return (clamp(-0.6*hitch,-30,30),1.0,look)
    # gap finding
    bb=180.0-hitch
    pts=[]
    for (_,wx,wy) in PTS:
        dx=wx-X; dy=wy-Y
        pts.append((dx*c+dy*s, -dx*s+dy*c))
    best=[]
    res=[]
    for a in range(-60,61,4):
        br=math.radians(bb-a); ux=math.cos(br); uy=math.sin(br)
        fd=10.0
        for (px,py) in pts:
            dx=px-R[0]; dy=py-R[1]
            al=dx*ux+dy*uy
            if al<0.2 or al>=fd: continue
            pe=abs(-dx*uy+dy*ux)
            if pe<hw+0.3: fd=al
        res.append((a,fd))
    mx=max(f for a,f in res)
    good=[a for a,f in res if f>=mx-0.6]
    good.sort()
    agap=good[len(good)//2] if good else 0
    if mx>9.5:
        # many free; prefer near straight among free
        agap=min(good,key=lambda a:abs(a-0.3*agap)) if good else 0
    aim=agap
    tg=obs.get('target',{})
    spd=-0.9
    if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('dist_m') is not None:
        e=rig['eye']; b=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); d=tg['dist_m']
        tx=e[0]+d*math.cos(b); ty=e[1]+d*math.sin(b)
        brt=math.degrees(math.atan2(ty-R[1],tx-R[0]))
        at=wrap(bb-brt)
        dr=math.hypot(tx-R[0],ty-R[1])
        if abs(at)<70:
            w=0.8 if d<14 else 0.5
            aim=w*at+(1-w)*agap
        if d<8: spd=-0.6
    phd=clamp(0.8*aim,-30,30)
    ph=math.radians(hitch)
    ff=math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(ph)/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(ph))))
    steer=clamp(ff+1.6*(hitch-phd),-45,45)
    if abs(hitch-phd)>15: spd=max(spd,-0.6)
    if t-lastprint>3:
        lastprint=t
        print('t%.1f h%.1f aim%.0f gap%.0f mx%.1f phd%.0f st%.0f n%d rem%s'%(t,hitch,aim,agap,mx,phd,steer,len(pts),rem))
    return (steer,spd,look)

import math
X=0.0;Y=0.0;YAW=0.0
MAP={}
phase='A';A0=(0.0,0.0)
gi=0;gt=0.0
GSEQ=[-64,64,150,-64,-150,64]
lp=-10;ncall=0;hdf=30.0;woke=False;woke2=False;nstop=0
PATH=[(-2.0,0.6),(-5.0,0.6),(-8.0,4.2),(-10.6,7.8),(-13.5,11.0),(-17.0,12.0),(-35.0,12.0)]

def clamp(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def ffd(hd):
    ph=math.radians(hd)
    return math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(ph)/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(ph))))

def lookpt(px,py,L):
    best=None
    for i in range(len(PATH)-1):
        ax,ay=PATH[i];bx,by=PATH[i+1]
        dx=bx-ax;dy=by-ay;sl=math.hypot(dx,dy)
        u=clamp(((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/(sl*sl),0.0,1.0)
        qx=ax+u*dx;qy=ay+u*dy
        d=math.hypot(px-qx,py-qy)
        if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,i,u)
    d,i,u=best
    rem=L
    ax,ay=PATH[i];bx,by=PATH[i+1]
    sl=math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay)
    left=(1-u)*sl
    cx=ax+u*(bx-ax);cy=ay+u*(by-ay)
    while rem>left and i<len(PATH)-2:
        rem-=left;i+=1
        ax,ay=PATH[i];bx,by=PATH[i+1]
        sl=math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay);left=sl;cx,cy=ax,ay
    f=min(rem,left)/max(sl,1e-6)
    return cx+f*(bx-ax),cy+f*(by-ay),d

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,YAW,MAP,phase,A0,gi,gt,lp,ncall,hdf,woke,woke2,nstop
    ncall+=1
    t=obs['t'];dt=obs.get('dt') or 0.1
    mo=obs['motion'];v=mo['v_mps'];st=obs['steer_deg']
    YAW+=v*math.tan(math.radians(st))/2.5*dt
    X+=v*math.cos(YAW)*dt;Y+=v*math.sin(YAW)*dt
    c=math.cos(YAW);s=math.sin(YAW)
    views=obs.get('views') or {}
    for k,vw in views.items():
        if not vw: continue
        o=vw.get('origin') or [0,0]
        for w in vw.get('walls') or []:
            b,d=w[0],w[1]
            if d>12: continue
            px=o[0]+d*math.cos(math.radians(b));py=o[1]+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))
            wx=X+px*c-py*s;wy=Y+px*s+py*c
            MAP[(int(round(wx/0.25)),int(round(wy/0.25)))]=(t,wx,wy)
    if ncall%10==0:
        MAP={kk:q for kk,q in MAP.items() if t-q[0]<4}
    head=obs['head']
    if head.get('settled'):
        if gt==0: gt=t
        if t-gt>0.4:
            gi=(gi+1)%len(GSEQ);gt=0
    look=GSEQ[gi]
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    rig=obs['rig'];H=rig['hitch'];R=rig['trailer_rear']
    hw=rig.get('trailer_half_width') or 1.2;vhw=rig.get('vehicle_half_width') or 1.15
    vf=rig.get('vehicle_front')
    if isinstance(vf,(list,tuple)): vf=vf[0]
    if not isinstance(vf,(int,float)): vf=3.0
    vb=vf-3.9
    hr=math.radians(h);fx=math.cos(hr);fy=-math.sin(hr);nx=-fy;ny=fx
    dTR=9.0;dTL=9.0;dVL=9.0;dVR=9.0
    for (tt,wx,wy) in MAP.values():
        if t-tt>3.0: continue
        dx=wx-X;dy=wy-Y
        px=dx*c+dy*s;py=-dx*s+dy*c
        if px>vb-0.3:
            e1=max(vb-px,px-vf,0.0);e2=max(abs(py)-vhw,0.0)
            q=math.hypot(e1,e2)
            if py<0:
                if q<dVR: dVR=q
            else:
                if q<dVL: dVL=q
        ex=px-H[0];ey=py-H[1]
        a=-(ex*fx+ey*fy);l=ex*nx+ey*ny
        if a<0.0 or a>7 or abs(l)>5: continue
        e1=max(0.4-a,a-5.0,0.0);e2=max(abs(l)-hw,0.0)
        q=math.hypot(e1,e2)
        if l<0:
            if q<dTR: dTR=q
        else:
            if q<dTL: dTL=q
    rem=(obs.get('progress') or {}).get('remaining',99)
    if phase=='A':
        dist=math.hypot(X-A0[0],Y-A0[1])
        if dist>=1.3 or h>=38 or dVL<0.35 or dVR<0.12:
            phase='B'
            print('t%.1f endA dist%.2f h%.1f dVL%.2f dVR%.2f yaw%.0f'%(t,dist,h,dVL,dVR,math.degrees(YAW)))
        else:
            spd=0.5 if (st>20 or (mo.get('hold_s') or 0)>0) else 0.0
            if t-lp>1.0:
                lp=t;print('t%.1f A dist%.2f h%.1f st%.0f dVL%.2f dVR%.2f dTR%.2f'%(t,dist,h,st,dVL,dVR,dTR))
            return (45.0,spd,look)
    RX=X+R[0]*c-R[1]*s;RY=Y+R[0]*s+R[1]*c
    psib=math.degrees(YAW)-h+180.0
    lx,ly,cte=lookpt(RX,RY,3.5)
    des=math.degrees(math.atan2(ly-RY,lx-RX))
    e=wrap(des-psib)
    hd=clamp(-1.0*e,-46,46)
    if dTR<0.45: hd+=40*(0.45-dTR)
    if dTL<0.45: hd-=40*(0.45-dTL)
    hd=clamp(hd,-50,50)
    hdf+=0.4*(hd-hdf)
    steer=clamp(ffd(h)+1.6*(h-hdf),-45,45)
    spd=-0.4
    if min(dTR,dTL)<0.35 or abs(h-hdf)>12: spd=-0.25
    if min(dTR,dTL)<0.08 or min(dVL,dVR)<0.1 or abs(h)>58:
        nstop+=1;spd=0.0
        if nstop>2 and not woke:
            woke=True;wake('safety stop: h%.1f dTR%.2f dTL%.2f dVL%.2f dVR%.2f R(%.1f,%.1f) yaw%.0f'%(h,dTR,dTL,dVL,dVR,RX,RY,math.degrees(YAW)))
    else:
        nstop=0
    if RY>5.5 and not woke2:
        woke2=True;wake('approaching 2nd bend: R(%.1f,%.1f) yaw%.0f h%.1f rem%s'%(RX,RY,math.degrees(YAW),h,rem))
    if t-lp>2.0:
        lp=t
        print('t%.1f B h%.1f hd%.0f e%.0f psib%.0f R(%.1f,%.1f) cte%.2f dTR%.2f dTL%.2f dVL%.2f dVR%.2f st%.0f rem%s'%(t,h,hdf,e,psib,RX,RY,cte,dTR,dTL,dVL,dVR,steer,rem))
    return (steer,spd,look)

import math
X=0.0;Y=0.0;PSI=0.0
yref=0.0
mode='rev'
L1=1.25
last_print=-10

def clip(a,lo,hi):
    return max(lo,min(hi,a))

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,PSI,yref,mode,last_print
    dt=obs.get('dt',0.1) or 0.1
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']
    d=math.radians(obs['steer_deg'])
    X+=v*math.cos(PSI)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(PSI)*dt
    PSI+=v*math.tan(d)/L1*dt
    rig=obs['rig']
    tr=rig['trailer_rear']
    ty=Y+tr[0]*math.sin(PSI)+tr[1]*math.cos(PSI)
    hitch=obs['hitch_deg']
    th=math.degrees(PSI)+rig['trailer_heading_deg']
    rem=obs['progress']['remaining']
    tg=obs.get('target') or {}
    if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('dist_m') is not None and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None and tg['dist_m']>1.0:
        b=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); dd=tg['dist_m']
        ex,ey=rig['eye']
        px=ex+dd*math.cos(b); py=ey+dd*math.sin(b)
        wy=Y+px*math.sin(PSI)+py*math.cos(PSI)
        wy=clip(wy,-1.0,1.0)
        yref+=0.1*(wy-yref)
    if mode=='fwd':
        if abs(hitch)<5:
            mode='rev'
        else:
            return (0.0,0.6,0.0)
    if abs(hitch)>40:
        mode='fwd'
        return (0.0,0.6,0.0)
    ey_=ty-yref
    lim=15.0 if rem>2.5 else 5.0
    th_des=clip(25.0*ey_,-lim,lim)
    h_des=clip(1.5*(th-th_des),-20,20)
    steer=clip(4.0*(hitch-h_des),-45,45)
    spd=-0.6 if rem>1.5 else -0.4
    if obs['t']-last_print>3:
        last_print=obs['t']
        print('t%.1f ty%.2f yref%.2f th%.1f h%.1f st%.1f rem%.2f'%(obs['t'],ty,yref,th,hitch,steer,rem))
    return (steer,spd,160.0)

T=None
mode='rev'
L1=1.25
lp=-10

def clip(a,lo,hi):
    return max(lo,min(hi,a))

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,P,T,mode,lp
    dt=obs.get('dt',0.1) or 0.1
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']
    d=math.radians(obs['steer_deg'])
    X+=v*math.cos(P)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(P)*dt
    P+=v*math.tan(d)/L1*dt
    rig=obs['rig']
    hitch=obs['hitch_deg']
    rem=obs['progress']['remaining']
    tg=obs.get('target') or {}
    if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('dist_m') is not None and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None:
        b=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); dd=tg['dist_m']
        ex,ey=rig['eye']
        px=ex+dd*math.cos(b); py=ey+dd*math.sin(b)
        wx=X+px*math.cos(P)-py*math.sin(P); wy=Y+px*math.sin(P)+py*math.cos(P)
        if T is None: T=[wx,wy]
        else:
            a=0.2 if dd>2 else 0.08
            T[0]+=a*(wx-T[0]); T[1]+=a*(wy-T[1])
    look=180.0
    if mode=='fwd':
        if abs(hitch)<10:
            mode='rev'
        else:
            return (0.0,0.5,170.0)
    if abs(hitch)>45:
        mode='fwd'
        return (0.0,0.5,170.0)
    tr=rig['trailer_rear']
    back=180.0+rig['trailer_heading_deg']
    hdes=0.0; e=0.0; dist=0.0
    if T is not None:
        dx=T[0]-X; dy=T[1]-Y
        x=dx*math.cos(P)+dy*math.sin(P); y=-dx*math.sin(P)+dy*math.cos(P)
        rx=x-tr[0]; ry=y-tr[1]
        dist=math.hypot(rx,ry)
        bt=math.degrees(math.atan2(ry,rx))
        e=wrap(bt-back)
        lim=30 if dist>2.0 else 12
        if dist>0.6:
            hdes=clip(-1.2*e,-lim,lim)
        look=clip(wrap(bt),-170,170)
    steer=clip(2.5*(hitch-hdes),-45,45)
    spd=-0.4 if rem>1.5 else -0.3
    if obs['t']-lp>2:
        lp=obs['t']
        print('t%.1f e%.1f dist%.2f h%.1f hd%.1f st%.1f rem%.2f T%s'%(obs['t'],e,dist,hitch,hdes,steer,rem,str(T and [round(T[0],2),round(T[1],2)])))
    return (steer,spd,look)

import math
X=0.0;Y=0.0;P=0.0
T=[-4.4,-8.4]
T0=(-4.4,-8.4)
U=(-0.52,-0.85)
mode='fwd'
lp=-10
woke=False

def clip(a,lo,hi):
    return max(lo,min(hi,a))

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def path():
    P1=(T[0]-3.0*U[0],T[1]-3.0*U[1])
    E=(T[0]+3.0*U[0],T[1]+3.0*U[1])
    return [(6.0,-2.32),(-0.95,-0.79),P1,(T[0],T[1]),E]

def pursue(px,py,pts,Ld):
    best=None
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        ax,ay=pts[i];bx,by=pts[i+1]
        dx=bx-ax;dy=by-ay;L=math.hypot(dx,dy)
        s=clip(((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/(L*L),0,1)
        qx=ax+s*dx;qy=ay+s*dy
        d=math.hypot(px-qx,py-qy)
        if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,i,s)
    d,i,s=best
    ax,ay=pts[i];bx,by=pts[i+1]
    L=math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay)
    rem=(1-s)*L
    togo=rem+sum(math.hypot(pts[j+1][0]-pts[j][0],pts[j+1][1]-pts[j][1]) for j in range(i+1,3))
    if i>=3: togo=-s*L
    left=Ld
    while True:
        ax,ay=pts[i];bx,by=pts[i+1]
        L=math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay)
        avail=(1-s)*L
        if left<=avail or i==len(pts)-2:
            f=s+left/L
            return (ax+f*(bx-ax),ay+f*(by-ay),togo,d)
        left-=avail;i+=1;s=0.0

    r=math.radians(h)

import math
X=0.0;Y=0.0;P=0.0
W=[]
mode='fwd'
fx=0.0
lp=-10
woke=False

def clip(a,lo,hi):
    return max(lo,min(hi,a))

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def deq(h):
    r=math.radians(h)
    return math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(r)/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(r))))

def fit(pts,A):
    n=len(pts)
    if n<2: return None
    ma=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/n; ml=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/n
    va=sum((p[0]-ma)**2 for p in pts)/n
    if va<0.1: m=0.0
    else:
        m=clip(sum((p[0]-ma)*(p[1]-ml) for p in pts)/n/va,-0.4,0.4)
    return ml+m*(A-ma)

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,P,W,mode,fx,lp,woke
    dt=obs.get('dt') or 0.1
    t=obs['t']
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps'];d=math.radians(obs['steer_deg'])
    X+=v*math.cos(P)*dt;Y+=v*math.sin(P)*dt;P+=v*math.tan(d)/1.25*dt
    c=math.cos(P);s=math.sin(P)
    rig=obs['rig'];hitch=obs['hitch_deg'];tr=rig['trailer_rear']
    rem=obs['progress']['remaining']
    for k,vw in (obs.get('views') or {}).items():
        o=vw['origin']
        for b,r in vw.get('walls',[]) or []:
            px=o[0]+r*math.cos(math.radians(b));py=o[1]+r*math.sin(math.radians(b))
            W.append((t,X+px*c-py*s,Y+px*s+py*c))
    W=[w for w in W if t-w[0]<3.0][-800:]
    if mode=='fwd':
        if obs['motion']['hold_s']<=0: fx+=abs(v)*dt
        if fx<1.0:
            return (0.0,0.5,170.0)
        mode='rev'
    if mode=='unfold':

import math
X=0.2;Y=0.3;P=math.radians(-3.0)
R0=(-0.86,-0.80)
D=(-0.829,-0.559)
NI=(-0.559,0.829)
F0=(1.5,0.58)
Fd=(0.974,0.225)
off=0.9
mode='fwd'
fx=0.0
lp=-10
woke=False

def clip(a,lo,hi):
    return max(lo,min(hi,a))

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def deq(h):
    r=math.radians(h)
    return math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(r)/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(r))))

def path():
    A=(R0[0]+off*NI[0],R0[1]+off*NI[1])
    det=Fd[0]*(-D[1])-Fd[1]*(-D[0])
    rx=A[0]-F0[0];ry=A[1]-F0[1]
    a=(rx*(-D[1])-ry*(-D[0]))/det
    C=(F0[0]+a*Fd[0],F0[1]+a*Fd[1])
    S=(C[0]+6.0*Fd[0],C[1]+6.0*Fd[1])
    E=(C[0]+4.5*D[0],C[1]+4.5*D[1])
    return [S,C,E]

def pursue(px,py,pts,Ld):
    best=None
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        ax,ay=pts[i];bx,by=pts[i+1]
        dx=bx-ax;dy=by-ay;L=math.hypot(dx,dy)
        s=clip(((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/(L*L),0,1)
        d=math.hypot(px-ax-s*dx,py-ay-s*dy)
        if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,i,s)
    d,i,s=best
    left=Ld
    while True:
        ax,ay=pts[i];bx,by=pts[i+1]
        L=math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay)
        avail=(1-s)*L
        if left<=avail or i==len(pts)-2:
            f=s+left/L
            return (ax+f*(bx-ax),ay+f*(by-ay),d)
        left-=avail;i+=1;s=0.0

    global X,Y,P,off,mode,fx,lp,woke
    dt=obs.get('dt') or 0.1
    t=obs['t']
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps'];d=math.radians(obs['steer_deg'])

    rig=obs['rig'];hitch=obs['hitch_deg'];tr=rig['trailer_rear']
    rem=obs['progress']['remaining']

        b=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']);r=tg['dist_m'];e=rig['eye']
        px=e[0]+r*math.cos(b);py=e[1]+r*math.sin(b)
        wx=X+px*c-py*s;wy=Y+px*s+py*c
        lo_=(wx-R0[0])*NI[0]+(wy-R0[1])*NI[1]
        if math.hypot(wx-trx,wy-tryy)>1.0:

        st=math.degrees(math.atan(2*1.25*ly/(lx*lx+ly*ly)))
        herr=wrap(math.degrees(P)-math.degrees(math.atan2(Fd[1],Fd[0])))
        if (fx>=2.0 and abs(lat)<0.2 and abs(herr)<6 and abs(hitch)<6) or fx>=3.0:
            mode='rev'
            print('REV start X%.2f Y%.2f P%.1f h%.1f fx%.2f'%(X,Y,math.degrees(P),hitch,fx))
        else:
            if t-lp>1.5:
                lp=t;print('F t%.1f X%.2f Y%.2f P%.1f lat%.2f h%.1f st%.1f'%(t,X,Y,math.degrees(P),lat,hitch,st))
            return (clip(st,-25,25),0.5,0.0)
    if mode=='unfold':
        if abs(hitch)<12: mode='rev'
        else: return (clip(-0.5*hitch,-20,20),0.4,170.0)
    if abs(hitch)>40:
        mode='unfold'
        return (clip(-0.5*hitch,-20,20),0.4,170.0)
    pts=path()
    qx,qy,xte=pursue(trx,tryy,pts,1.2)
    back=math.degrees(P)+180.0+rig['trailer_heading_deg']
    bt=math.degrees(math.atan2(qy-tryy,qx-trx))
    e=wrap(bt-back)
    lim=30 if rem>1.5 else 10
    hdes=clip(-1.3*e,-lim,lim)
    steer=clip(deq(hdes)+2.0*(hitch-hdes),-45,45)
    spd=-0.3 if rem>1.0 else -0.22
    if rem<-0.7:
        spd=0.0
        if not woke:
            woke=True;wake('past bay centre, stopped rem %.2f'%rem)
    dx=qx-X;dy=qy-Y
    lx=dx*c+dy*s-0.1;ly=-dx*s+dy*c
    look=clip(math.degrees(math.atan2(ly,lx)),-170,170)
    if t-lp>1.5:
        lp=t
        print('R t%.1f rem%.2f tr(%.2f,%.2f) xte%.2f off%.2f e%.1f h%.1f hd%.1f st%.1f P%.1f'%(t,rem,trx,tryy,xte,off,e,hitch,hdes,steer,math.degrees(P)))
